name: Amemura Ramuda
source:
A former member of The Dirty Dawg.

A designer for the fashion brand Empty Candy.

He’s highly popular with women thanks to his pop-inspired, cute personality.

[spoiler]He is a clone developed with the involvement of Zero, and once operated in secret as a collaborator of Chuo Ward.

After overcoming various hardships, he’s now able to speak honestly with Gentaro and Dice.
He aims to create a colorful and interesting world where each person’s individuality is recognized.
